stem.text: A projectile is fired from point P with velocity $V$ at an angle $\theta$ to the horizontal. It lands at point Q, a horizontal distance $R$ from P. Air resistance is negligible.

stem.alt: Path of a projectile from point P to point Q, with velocity V shown at angle θ to a dashed horizontal line, and horizontal distance R marked between P and Q.

stem.text: The acceleration of free fall is $g$.
